lines.en: Let's clean the fridge together this afternoon.
Fine. What is in this old container?
lines.ko: 좋아요. 이 오래된 용기에는 뭐가 있어요?

lines.en: That is soup. I made it last week.
Does it still smell fresh?
No, it will spoil soon. Please take it out.
lines.ko: 아니요, 곧 상할 거예요. 꺼내 주세요.

lines.en: The bread here is a little stale too.
Put it in the freezer, please.
Where should I put the frozen fish?
Beside the ice, please. Check the expiration date.
lines.ko: 얼음 옆에 두세요. 유통기한도 확인해 주세요.

lines.en: Thank you. I will use an airtight container.

dialogs.about: 가게에서 보관 용기를 고르며 점원에게 묻는 이야기

lines.en: Hello. I am looking for a food container.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 음식 담을 용기를 찾고 있어요.

lines.en: We have many. Do you want an airtight one?
Yes. My bread went stale last week.
This one keeps food fresh for many days.
lines.ko: 이건 음식을 여러 날 신선하게 지켜 줘요.

lines.en: Can I put it in the freezer?
Yes, frozen food is fine in it.
Good. How much is this one?
Ten thousand won. Please check expiration dates too.
I will. Vegetables rot fast in summer.
True. Nothing will spoil in an airtight container.
lines.ko: 맞아요. 밀폐 용기에서는 아무것도 상하지 않아요.
